name: Sapporo
type: big city; city for international conferences and tourism; prefectural capital of Japan; city designated by government ordinance; city of Japan
text: Sapporo is a designated city in Hokkaido, Japan. Located in the southwest of Hokkaido, it lies within the alluvial fan of the Toyohira River, a tributary of the Ishikari River. Sapporo is the capital of Hokkaido Prefecture and Ishikari Subprefecture.
